summary: Critical outage in checkout-api caused by queue_backlog (INC-0037)
description: Service checkout-api incident INC-0037. Symptoms: Kafka consumer lag exceeding 500k messages. Error: kafka.errors.BufferError: Queue is full and cannot accept more messages. Root cause was queue_backlog. Followed runbook RB-queue-backlog.

comments.author: devops1
comments.body: Restarted service pods for checkout-api and applied RB-queue-backlog.
